adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `destinationCalendar` an array and, for COLLECTIVE team event types, appends each team member’s `user.destinationCalendar` into `evt.destinationCalendar` without any deduplication (handleNewBooking.ts: `teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` and later `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). Event creation now iterates `event.destinationCalendar` and creates an event per entry (EventManager.ts `createAllCalendarEvents`: `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar) { ... createEvent(...) }`). Therefore, if the event type destination calendar equals a member’s destination calendar, or multiple members share the same destination calendar/credential, the same calendar can be processed multiple times, producing duplicate events on the same external calendar.
